name: shield
description: Deposits an origin mint into the shielded pool and emits the note commitment

name: unshield
description: Withdraws from the shielded pool into origin or twin mints

name: transfer
description: Private in-pool transfers (feature flagged for v1.1)

name: batch_transfer
description: Batch private transfers supporting 2 different token transfers in a single proof

name: batch_transfer_from
description: Batch private transfers from (with approvals) supporting 2 different token transfers in a single proof
